newsitem.title: USA: Genetics Institute in discovery pacts.
newsitem.headline: Genetics Institute in discovery pacts.

text.p: Genetics Institute Inc said on Wednesday Chiron Corp and Genentech Inc had signed up as partners in Genetics Institute's protein discovery program.
Genetics Insititue's DiscoverEase protein development platform is a genomics program designed to quickly isolate and determine functions of key proteins, leading to potential new drugs.
Terms were not disclosed but Genetics Institute said partners will pay a low up-front fee for access to its library of human recombinant proteins and full-length genes.
Partners are able to select individual proteins from the library and to exclusively license Genetics Institute patents and on a first-come, first-serve basis.
Genetics Institute retains an option to co-develop and co-commercialize the resulting products, the company said.
Genetics Institute expects to sign up more biotech and pharmaceutical companies in the DiscoverEase program in coming months, chief operating officer Patrick Gage said.
"We're targeting 10 or more partners by the end of next year," Gage said in an interview.
